The '''48th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and [[television]] for 1990, were held on January 19, 1991, at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Fox|first1=David|title=A Golden Evening for 'Dances With Wolves'|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1991-01-21-ca-586-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=21 January 1991}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 27, 1990.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Fox|first1=David|title='Godfather' Wins 7 Golden Globe Nominations|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1990-12-28-ca-7405-story.html|access-date=17 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=28 December 1990}}</ref>
